capabilities: Roll random entries from every pool in a Markdown table at once
Re-roll individual pools and roll N non-repeating entries with ×N multi-select
Weight table faces and fill placeholders from word-bank pools
Reference and nest pools within a file or across files via links
Save results as named notes or export them as PNG/JPG images
extras: Ships with a built-in bilingual (Chinese/English) user manual under Settings → Dice Table → User manual; makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to roll random results from Markdown tables and persist the rolled outcome.
summary: Random-table roller that reads Markdown dice tables, draws one entry per pool, and saves results as notes or PNG/JPG images.
